title: A 28-byte text memo that is not valid UTF-8, mapped into the transfer event
pattern: MEMO_TEXT holds 28 raw bytes that are not UTF-8 (the maximum length). CAP-0067 copies it into the payment's transfer event as to_muxed_id (a string). Readers that decode either as UTF-8 lose or mangle it.

hazards.placement: MEMO_TEXT bytes that are not UTF-8
MEMO_TEXT carried into the transfer event as to_muxed_id (string)

facts.says: The memo text is 28 bytes, first ff fe 00.
The transfer event carries the same bytes as to_muxed_id.
